title: Sandbox & staged-rollout checklist for tokens, interactive components, and charts
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Create a lightweight, reproducible sandbox and a staged-rollout checklist that design contributors must complete for non-trivial changes to tokens, interactive components (buttons, tables), and charts. The checklist will standardize pre-merge acceptance criteria, cross-team signoffs, telemetry hooks, and a rollback plan so we can safely iterate on primitives without surprising production customers.

Scope:
- Applies to changes that alter visual tokens (color, spacing, type scales), interaction states, or chart defaults that can cause visual/regression or accessibility impacts.
- Includes guidance for experimental flags, canary rollout windows, and post-rollout monitoring targets.

Out of scope:
- Small copy/text fixes that do not impact token values or interaction behavior.
- Ad-hoc one-off product-specific wrappers that are not part of the canonical component library.
review_checklist: Design spec posted to Drive with migration notes and examples (light/dark/compact) - link included
Automated visual diffs across core viewports (desktop/tablet/mobile) - no unexpected diffs
Token migration plan: mapping from old->new values, codemods if needed
Accessibility audit: color contrast, focus order, keyboard nav, ARIA roles
Interaction states validated with recordable regressions (hover, focus, disabled, loading)
Chart regression tests for axes/scales/legend/tooltip alignment and responsive behavior
Performance check: initial render and first meaningful paint benchmarks for affected routes
Telemetry hooks added: rollout flag, percent_of_traffic, error/event counters
Canary rollout plan with % increments and SLO gates defined (latency, error, visual regression rate)
Rollback plan and revert PR template created
Documentation updated: component READMEs, migration guide, release notes
Cross-team signoff recorded (Design, Platform Engineering, Accessibility, Product)
Post-merge smoke tests and 72h health check schedule
acceptance_criteria: All checklist items completed and each item referenced in the PR description
Sandbox reproducer available (codesandbox/preview link) demonstrating old vs new tokens/components
No >5% visual regression metrics across our primary snapshots or approved exceptions documented
Accessibility issues resolved or tracked with remediation tickets and timeline
Telemetry is surfaced in Console dashboards for the rollout and alerts are configured for SLO breaches
